column2: Every field the front end sends to or receives from the PHACT API, by screen. Names are exact.
Filter the API Contract tab by Screen, Endpoint, or Status. Field names in column F are what appears in the JSON.
Deployed in phases 1 and 2. Call it in live mode.
Phases 3 and 4 (shaded rows). Not built yet, but the backend will use exactly these names, so build against them in mock mode now.
Send the Cognito ID token, raw, with no "Bearer " prefix.
The ID token's cognito:groups claim contains faculty or admin. Use it to show or hide admin navigation.
The API leaves out fields that have no value. Treat a missing field as null.
Every error returns {code, message, requestId}. Show message to the user as written.
After deploy, copy them from ASPPH/PHACT/.phact/outputs.json into frontend/.env.local.
Backend code and README in ASPPH/PHACT/. Architecture doc: PHACT Architecture (MVP).
